items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Then they had a, well, this fella, a young fella, when he came along, Alvin Alcorn, he played with him.

ctx.x: Well, they had a son playing it sometime? Well, his son played sometime when he was here. That's before he left here. Before he left. Yeah, he played. Then they had a fella called Wooden Joe. Oh, yeah. He used to play with him. Then they had a, well, this fella, a young fella, when he came along, Alvin Alcorn, he played with him. And they had, let's see who it is. Well, Poison, or Willie Alfre, he played with him too. Clarinet. Yeah, he played Clarinet. Yeah. During that time, they only used Clarinet in the band…
